purpose: Superseded historical gameplay-need-first working map. Production-v1/category-cartography.json is the active 904-claim authoring inventory; this draft is retained for provenance only and is not a profile closure, materialization catalogue, claim approval, or competing authoritative map.

method.need_source: PR92 plan sections 7-18 and 37, expanded by open-world causal gameplay needs rather than current claim families.
method.claim_check: Existing claim refs were checked against production-v1 authoring inputs. A sample ref demonstrates relevant support; it does not make a family complete.
method.authority_boundary: Claims describe factual premises only. @rus/turn owns semantic planning; body/combat/time, inventory/container, spatial topology, materialization, access and persistence owners decide state, mechanics and commit.

staged_candidate_reconciliation.purpose: Maps 33 staged factual claims to gameplay needs without treating them as approved, retrieved, materialized, or production coverage.
still_missing_after_candidate_review: taxon-specific plant applicability and historical presence
staged_candidate_reconciliation.limits: Promotion requires separate verification and descriptor inclusion. Even an approved candidate is a factual premise, not a scene fact, recipe, safe-use instruction, or exact mechanics.

parent_needs.location_applicability: all locations; exact geometry, mass and state are scene supplied
parent_needs.reason: Core qualitative contact and support relations exist; rope/knot systems, fatigue/wear, water/air drag and open composed failures remain uneven.
parent_needs.limits: No numeric universal simulator, hit result, fall, break, or current load follows.

parent_needs.location_applicability: river, lake, shore, vessel and wet-work contexts
parent_needs.reason: General fluid premises exist; wave action, water resistance by body/object form and river-specific transport remain incomplete.
parent_needs.limits: Does not establish depth, current, vessel safety or a present floating object.

parent_needs.location_applicability: hearth, kiln, campfire and authored fire contexts
parent_needs.reason: Combustion prerequisites and heat transfer are grounded; applied water extinguishing remains a sourced composition candidate, not an approved outcome family.
parent_needs.limits: No fire, suppression success, smoke exposure, quantity or safety result is inferred.

parent_needs.location_applicability: all materialized objects and workspaces
parent_needs.reason: Major material classes have qualitative relations, but coverage is not an exhaustive material-property table and cross-material joins remain selective.
parent_needs.limits: No item, quality grade, exact strength, source or output is created.

parent_needs.location_applicability: household, storage, cooking and exposure contexts
parent_needs.reason: Relevant qualitative relations exist; dose, diagnosis, exact reaction outputs and a universal reaction solver are intentionally absent.
parent_needs.limits: No poison, illness, spoilage finding, treatment or current food state follows.

parent_needs.location_applicability: all actor contexts
parent_needs.reason: Basic reflex/respiration facts exist; v3 proposals identify missing bounded causal premises without authorizing forced actions.
parent_needs.limits: No actor state, unconsciousness, reflex success or autonomous action is decided by knowledge.

parent_needs.location_applicability: all actor contexts
parent_needs.reason: Known body processes have support; severity, thresholds, duration and current condition correctly remain body-owned.
parent_needs.limits: No diagnosis, prognosis, treatment or numeric effect.

parent_needs.location_applicability: only after animal identity and perceptual basis are established
parent_needs.reason: General learning and selected species responses exist; generic deterministic flight, freeze or aggression must not be inferred.
parent_needs.limits: No current animal, perception, emotion or action.

parent_needs.location_applicability: taxon and life-stage specific; no calendar creates an animal event
parent_needs.reason: Selected taxa cover incompatible strategies. The residual need is taxon-specific evidence, not a universal animal-season rule.
parent_needs.limits: No migration route, hibernation, nest, offspring or defensive act is materialized.

parent_needs.location_applicability: waterbody only when water state is separately established
parent_needs.reason: Temperature and low-oxygen consequences are covered; circulation and rain-linked candidates await review, while current water state remains external.
parent_needs.limits: No oxygen measurement, fish kill, species presence or water-quality finding.

parent_needs.location_applicability: universal factual context; actor knowledge/perception is separately bounded
parent_needs.reason: General mechanisms are grounded; no premise authorizes mind-reading or deterministic choice.
parent_needs.limits: No motive, belief, emotion or action of a concrete NPC.

parent_needs.location_applicability: universal interaction context; historical/legal application needs separate regional authority
parent_needs.reason: General social premises exist but are not medieval norms or individual outcomes.
parent_needs.limits: No consent, status, obligation, reputation or NPC decision follows.

parent_needs.location_applicability: regional Novgorod 1220-1240 where historical source applicability permits
parent_needs.reason: Historical fragments support qualified contexts; live law, authority and local custom require bindings and policy owners.
parent_needs.limits: No current legal rule, official status, transaction or obligation.

parent_needs.location_applicability: all landscapes; regional environment needs a historical/scene bridge
parent_needs.reason: Causal environmental mechanisms exist; scene weather, flood, route safety and exact terrain are not facts supplied by WK.
parent_needs.limits: No forecast, water level, ice thickness, visibility or local route condition.

parent_needs.location_applicability: Novgorod regional/historical envelope plus modern universal ecology; no scene plant presence
parent_needs.reason: Known reed/willow and qualified regional contexts do not provide a general tree/aquatic-herb functional envelope.
parent_needs.limits: No plant stand, season state, quantity, access or collection result.

parent_needs.location_applicability: only after specimen/source identity evidence; no generic edible-plant rule
parent_needs.reason: Only narrow look-alike/toxicity examples and flax/hemp material facts exist; wild fibre and edible identification remain open scoped evidence needs.
parent_needs.limits: No edible result, dose, competence, present specimen or historical availability.

parent_needs.location_applicability: riverbank, landing and floodplain only after hydrology/state establishes conditions
parent_needs.reason: Sediment and ice mechanisms do not establish large organic debris transport/stranding. Proposal correctly leaves a large-wood source gap.
parent_needs.limits: No branch, log, raft, cargo or collectible resource is implied.

parent_needs.location_applicability: regional built-space context; concrete contents need materialization
parent_needs.reason: Several built/work/storage relations exist; joined interior-function and ventilation/condensation coverage remains partial.
parent_needs.limits: No room, capacity, item, occupant, access or current activity.

parent_needs.location_applicability: storage and drying contexts after stored substance/state is established
parent_needs.reason: Inputs and broad storage condition are covered; v3 proposes bounded bulk-storage mechanisms without inferring a spoilage state.
parent_needs.limits: No food stock, current wetness, mould, duration, loss or safety determination.

parent_needs.location_applicability: landing, fishing camp and workshop after object/source presence
parent_needs.reason: Net/boat context and individual repair are grounded; modern net upkeep is only a proposal and historic wet-hull care is explicitly blocked.
parent_needs.limits: No net, boat, repair method, tool, skill, owner or completed maintenance.

parent_needs.location_applicability: regional Novgorod 1220-1240 compatibility plus universal process premises
parent_needs.reason: Many technology paths are represented, but corpus does not close all household/craft transformations or grant recipe admission.
parent_needs.limits: No tool, workshop, recipe, product or actor skill.

parent_needs.location_applicability: regional historical compatibility; object presence requires authoritative or ordinary materialization basis
parent_needs.reason: Corpus has extensive selected objects/materials; it is not an exhaustive inventory and does not establish party possession.
parent_needs.limits: No current item, authenticity, value, controller or location.

parent_needs.location_applicability: regional work/household contexts; current NPC is separately materialized
parent_needs.reason: Occupation/routine premises exist; decision choice, knowledge and action execution remain NPC/runtime owners.
parent_needs.limits: No NPC roster, schedule, intent, skill level or action.

parent_needs.location_applicability: all locations, with authoritative geography and profile bindings required for canonical/significant facts
parent_needs.reason: Source facts distinguish regional compatibility from scene state, but no template/profile closure has been validated by this research draft.
parent_needs.limits: No canonical location, hidden fact, local stock, route, profile binding or scene presence.

Exact spread belongs to runtime mechanics.
Needs independent direct-source review; no canned outcome.
No threshold is required in WK.
Needs a real gameplay consumer and historical source; no generic chemistry engine.
Knowledge must not force a turn.
Requires current site/source state, not more generic facts.
Rooted/floating/submerged classes still need bounded sources.
Flax/hemp do not establish nettle/lime/cattail fibre.
Cultivated flax candidate, not wild-fibre closure.
No fact can decide a current judgement.
Each future historical claim must retain its own date/place/source boundary; no broad closure.
Needs review; must not populate rooms.
Open semantics must compose primitives, not require a recipe whitelist.
Context and an individual repair fact.
Explicit historical blocker; do not infer from nets.
State and semantic decision, not missing factual coverage.

additional_discovery_needs.reason: No gameplay need currently identifies a consuming owner; investigate only when materialization/NPC ecology needs it.
Open actions can need it; existing force/fibre facts do not yet supply a bounded rope-system relation.
Selected animal facts cannot be generalized across fauna; add only a scenario-relevant taxon/class source.
Built-space context exists; broad ordinary categories need source and consumer-specific review, not a room-item whitelist.

review_requirements: Do not promote a proposal reference without independent source/domain verification.
Do not convert any partial/covered family into profile/template closure without validating active authoritative bindings and real consumers.
Keep universal mechanism, historical applicability, scene presence, actor knowledge and exact mechanics separate.
A missing family is a research priority, not an action prohibition or a cataloguing requirement.
